description: Provenance of every numerical parameter of the simulation and of the onboard software: value and code location, verdict class, source, identifiers, derivation, validity, citation keys (references.bib). R1-R3 are the parameter audits and DI-n the design-iteration notes, both in the external archive.

verdict_classes.SUPPORTED: a source of class (a) or (b) reports the value or range under conditions that map onto the model
verdict_classes.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: only part of the value is supported (an order of magnitude, a best case, the magnitudes but not the structure)
verdict_classes.DERIVED: follows from a stated source or model by a formula, from a measurement in our simulator, or from a formal check
verdict_classes.DESIGN_CHOICE: chosen by the project without an external source; feasibility may be checked against sources
verdict_classes.STRESS_ASSUMPTION: deliberately harsh or arbitrary setting; the phenomenon may be documented qualitatively but no source gives the value
verdict_classes.CONTRADICTED: a source or a computation contradicts the value or an assumption attached to it; the code action is stated in the row, and unresolved cases are listed in section 10

evidence_classes: (a) manufacturer specification; (b) peer-reviewed field or tank measurement; (c) derivation, with the formula given; (d) calibration in our own simulator; (e) assumption without empirical support.
model_idealisations: **Sonar ranges are geometric.** HoloOcean computes the Euclidean distance to the octree leaf; there is no sound-speed range error, no transmission loss, no beam pattern and no refraction. The bin value is the mean of R^2 cos over the leaves, so detection is range-independent up to `RangeMax` and uniform up to the cone edge; the water surface is not in the octree and is invisible (SONAR_PROBE.md (archive)). A sound-speed mismatch of 20 to 50 m/s would add a scale error of 1.3 to 3.4 % (+0.03 to +0.08 m at 2.4 m, +0.16 to +0.40 m at 12 m, DOSITS sensitivities); a hardware deployment needs c to about +-0.5 %.
**Rayleigh intensity noise** is optimistic against shallow-water field data (heavier tails). No acoustic interference between the 36 sonars of a six-drone fleet is modelled.
**Plant:** no added mass, no thruster deadzone or lag; isotropic drag.
**Compass:** the simulated magnetic vector is horizontal (no tilt coupling); the bias is constant per run, without heading dependence or time variation.

**Acoustic channel:** losses are independent per reception with a linear range ramp, while measured loss is position-dependent and correlated; the clock offset is constant per run (a TCXO-class clock or a mission beyond 1 h needs offset plus drift).
**B2 hardware** is research grade (section 7 and ACOUSTIC_CHANNEL_MODEL.md (archive)), not a COTS feature.

open_issues.title: MEDIUM sonar range jitter against the declared `eps_range`.
open_issues.text: `sensor_noise.MEDIUM.sonar_range_jitter_m` = 0.03 m shifts the whole profile by k = round(N(0, 0.03) / 0.05 m) bins (`holo_env._degrade`, no truncation). P(abs(k) >= 2) = 6.2e-3 per side. On the measured hull baselines (+0.044 to +0.054 m far side, -0.006 m near side) a shift of two bins gives +0.144 to +0.154 m and -0.106 m, while `Envelope.eps_range_far` = 0.12 m and `eps_range_near` = 0.08 m; the envelope would need about 0.154 m and 0.106 m. About 1.2 % of MEDIUM captures violate it for hull echoes (0.62 % per side); LOW is consistent (3e-7 per side). The anchor behind the jitter (Ping resolution 0.5 % of range) is a misread and does not support the value. *Code state*: values unchanged; the exceedance is now declared in the `sensor_noise.py` docstring and in the comment of `Envelope.eps_range_far` (MEDIUM is a stress level outside the proved P1 envelope). *Open*: nobody has yet counted how often a guard used such a capture. *Action* (R2 3b): report that count, or truncate the jitter at one bin for the validation levels.

open_issues.title: `structure_tol_far_m` against the MEDIUM `range_sigma`.
open_issues.text: `PerceptionConfig.structure_tol_far_m` = 0.70 m was derived for range_sigma 0.05 m (0.05 ln N, about 0.4 m for N = 10^3 leaves, DI-14). MEDIUM uses 0.10 m: the expected maximum offset over 100 / 300 / 1000 leaves is 0.52 / 0.63 / 0.75 m, and the probability that at least one leaf is pushed beyond 0.70 m is 0.09 / 0.24 / 0.60 per capture (8e-5 to 8e-4 at 0.05 m). A structure segment that passes `sw[1] + 0.70` fails `in_struct` (`sonar_processing.py:185`) and becomes UNKNOWN or DYNAMIC at the structure's own range. Not verified on logs. *Action* (R2 2d): replay logged MEDIUM profiles near gates with the tolerance scaled to range_sigma before attributing unexplained bar echoes to navigation drift.

open_issues.title: DVL measurement age.
open_issues.text: One `latency_s` (0.05 s at MEDIUM) applies to every onboard stream (`holo_env._tick`). The sources give 0.1 s (von Benzon Table 1) and 0.189 s (one example in the Water Linked documentation) between time of validity and delivery. Effect: a dead-reckoning offset v tau of 0.03 to 0.057 m at 0.30 m/s and additional phase lag in the DVL velocity loop. *Action* (R1 9.1): use 0.1 to 0.2 s for the DVL stream at MEDIUM, stamped with the time of validity.

open_issues.title: No DVL scale factor.
open_issues.text: `NoiseProfile` and `holo_env._degrade` contain white noise, dropouts and outages for the DVL but no long-term scale error. The A50 Standard is specified at +-1.01 %, the license-free Nortek at above 1 %, and the Wayfinder measured within +-1.15 %: up to 1 % of the distance travelled along track (0.3 m over a 30 m approach). *Action* (R1 4.3): a per-run, per-drone scale factor uniform in +-1 % for LOW and MEDIUM, or an explicit statement of the omission.

open_issues.title: LOW heading bias 0.5 deg is a best case.
open_issues.text: `NoiseProfile.heading_bias_deg` = 0.5 deg (LOW). Calibrated compasses reach 1 to 3 deg (Kinsey); MMC5983MA 1.0 deg typical; MAVBE about 1 deg; 0.55 deg after MAGYC in one experiment. *Action* (R1 6.1): raise LOW to 1.0 deg or label it "best-case in-situ calibration".

open_issues.title: MEDIUM navigation error against `nav_err_gate_m` = 1.0 m.
open_issues.text: `AcousticConfig.nav_err_gate_m` is the own position error assumed in the gate frame. A 2 deg heading bias reaches 1.0 m after a 28.6 m approach (27.5 m with a 1 % scale factor); R1 reports MEDIUM runs at 0.7 to 1.1 m, so the top end exceeds the assumption. The map aiding bounds the drift only inside the acquisition region (4.24 m) and only when a fit is accepted. *Action* (R1 8): cap the approach distance used in the gate argument, or raise the value to about 1.2 m if the DVL scale factor is added.

open_issues.title: `tau_max` has no margin at MEDIUM.
open_issues.text: `Envelope.tau_max` = 0.25 s; MEDIUM latency 0.05 s, capture period 0.1 s, dropout 1 %. R1: the newest sonar data are up to 0.15 s old just before the next capture and exactly 0.25 s after one dropped capture; R2 reaches the same boundary after two consecutive drops (1e-4 at 1 %) with a different age convention. The test is `age <= tau_max` (`sonar_processing.py:169`), a floating-point boundary. A MEDIUM blackout of 0.15 s exceeds `tau_max` by design (the sector becomes unhealthy, FAILSAFE is exercised); the `sensor_noise.py` docstring now states that MEDIUM exceeds `tau_max` with its outages. *Action* (R1 9.2): state that MEDIUM has no margin, or raise `tau_max` together with the staleness argument. EchoHold (commit 31efb0d) holds the nearest echo of every healthy sector for `tau_max`.

open_issues.title: `heading_err_deg` = 3.0 deg covers the MEDIUM compass bias but less than one standard deviation of its noise.
open_issues.text: `AcousticConfig.heading_err_deg` is "compass bias plus noise" for a MEDIUM bias of 2.0 deg, leaving 1.0 deg for noise. The heading used for a fix is the raw per-sample compass value (`nav.py`), whose MEDIUM noise is 57.3 x 0.02 = 1.15 deg (1 sigma, R1 6.2). With the envelope's own convention (k_sigma = 3) the bound would be 2.0 + 3 x 1.15 = 5.4 deg. Derived here from R1 and the code; not checked on logs. The envelope sums worst cases of independent terms, so the combined exceedance may still be small.

open_issues.title: MEDIUM channel against the one-way field figures.
open_issues.text: R3 P1 and P4: the MEDIUM white errors (range 0.15 m, direction 2.5 deg) lie at the datasheet end. The only published one-way inverted-USBL field statistics are 68 % of range errors below 0.7 m and of azimuth errors below 7.0 deg (static test, about 30 and 57 m, 7 to 11 kHz; Rypkema 2022) and -0.11 +- 3.16 deg (Rypkema and Schmidt 2019). The array bias and the clear-path episodes added since R3 narrow the gap in azimuth (the 68 % quantile is at most 4.2 deg at MEDIUM, computed here), not in range. *Action* (R3 P1, P4): a sensitivity level with range sigma of 0.5 to 0.7 m and direction sigma of 3 to 7 deg, and the requirement that the sender's trigger jitter is much smaller than 30 us.

open_issues.title: Residual-risk figures predate the widened envelope.
open_issues.text: The numbers behind `exit_confirm` = 3 (`results/calibration/b2_channel/channel_risk*.json`, dated 2026-10-29 02:00) were measured before `doa_bias_deg`, `los_outlier` and `los_excess_max_m` were added (code dated 22:46). They have not been re-run for this document.

1 Vehicle and plant: The simulated plant is HoloOcean 2.3.0 default dynamics for the BlueROV2, calibrated in closed loop (class d). It should not be called a BlueROV2 hydrodynamic model: the two experimental drag sources differ by a factor of about 3.6, and the isotropic engine drag cannot represent the measured anisotropy. The simulated horizontal thrust is about 0.15 (nominal authority) to 0.4 (full command) of a real Heavy.
2 Navigation sensors: CLEAN is the deployed suite; LOW and MEDIUM are the realistic operating domain of the validation campaign (`sim/sensor_noise.py`). Heading is `atan2(m_y, m_x)` of the raw magnetometer sample, the DVL body velocity is rotated by it and integrated, and depth comes from the pressure sensor; gyro and accelerometer do not enter the horizontal position estimate (`perception/nav.py`). The literature behind these values is summarised in SENSOR_DEGRADATION_REFERENCES.md (archive).
3 Sonar and HoloOcean: HoloOcean 2.3.0 semantics that differ from the documentation (R2 section B, engine source): `AddSigma` is the Rayleigh scale (the std of the added noise is 0.655 AddSigma, not AddSigma); `RangeSigma` is the mean of a one-sided exponential, one draw per octree leaf, not a standard deviation; `ShadowEpsilon` defaults to the octree leaf size for `SinglebeamSonar`, not to four leaves; `WaterSpeedSound` enters only the reflection coefficient, so ranges are geometric; the engine random generator is unseeded, so engine noise is not reproducible across runs.
4 Separation and envelope thresholds: `eps_range_far` and `eps_range_near`, `tau_max` and the other `Envelope` fields are assumptions of the formal proofs. The code states that each one is measured back on the logs (ASSUMPTIONS.md of the reference runs (archive)); the rows below record how the value was set.
5 Gate protocol (P2): The audit reports do not cover the gate parameters. No external literature applies: the values are design choices, derived from the geometry, or checked by the formal suites (`formal/check_mutex.py`, `formal/check_acoustic.py`).
6 Formation (P3): As for the gate, the values are design choices or follow from the formal ranking-function suite (`formal/check_formation.py`) and the design iterations in DESIGN_ITERATIONS.md (archive).
7 Acoustic B2 channel (simulator side): `sim/acoustic_channel.py` turns the exact geometry that HoloOcean's `AcousticBeaconSensor` returns into what a receiver would deliver. The hardware assumptions H1 to H5 and the full level table are in ACOUSTIC_CHANNEL_MODEL.md (archive). A commercial micro-USBL figure is a two-way (interrogation-reply) specification and does not by itself support a one-way travel-time error model (R3, general caveat).
8 Onboard acoustic envelope (`AcousticCo: The perception never knows the channel level of a run. It uses the declared envelope below, fixed before any B2 result: the MEDIUM channel at k_sigma = 3, extended by the array calibration bias, the own attitude error and a one-sided range excess for clear-path multipath.

parameters.parameter: HULL_HALF (hull box half extents; R_IN, R_OUT)
parameters.source: (a) manufacturer: BlueROV2 Heavy 457 x 575 x 254 mm (the Heavy kit moves two extra thrusters outside the frame); independent CAD (von Benzon Table 5): 0.46 x 0.38 x 0.58 m, height larger than the manufacturer's 254 mm (R1 1.1)
parameters.derivation: half extent = dimension / 2 (0.2285 / 0.2875 / 0.127 m, rounded up by 0.5 mm); R_IN = min half extent = 0.127 m; R_OUT = norm of the half extents = 0.389 m
parameters.validity: Bare vehicle as sold. A payload that enlarges the envelope (CAD height 0.38 m) needs a larger R_OUT, which enters Envelope.d_upper_offset; a box only bounds an open frame

parameters.parameter: Vehicle mass (HoloOcean MassInKG; not set by the repository)
parameters.source: (a) Heavy kit page: 11.5 kg (26 lb) with ballast; BlueROV2 page 11-12 kg; Wu 2018 Table 5.1: 11.5 kg; von Benzon Table A1: 13.5 kg measured (R1 1.2)
parameters.doi_or_url: https://bluerobotics.com/store/rov/bluerov2-upgrade-kits/brov2-heavy-retrofit/; https://bluerobotics.com/store/rov/bluerov2/; 10.3390/jmse10121898; https://flex.flinders.edu.au/file/27aa0064-9de2-441c-8a17-655405d5fc2e/1/ThesisWu2018.pdf; local copy of the patched HoloOcean source
parameters.derivation: surge inertia with added mass would be 13.5 + 6.36 = 19.9 kg (von Benzon), 55 % above the simulated 11.5 kg
parameters.validity: The engine models no added mass; this mainly affects transients such as braking, which are calibrated in closed loop in the simulator (see a_brake)

parameters.parameter: Thruster force limit per unit command
parameters.source: project choice, conservative against every source (R1 1.4 verdict: DERIVED, class d): T200 forward thrust 36.4 N at 12 V and 51.5 N at 16 V; von Benzon regression F(1) = 30.4 N; Gabl whole-vehicle bollard force 92 N forward; HoloOcean clamp 28.75 N (R1 1.4)
parameters.doi_or_url: https://bluerobotics.com/store/thrusters/t100-t200-thrusters/t200-thruster-r2-rp/; https://bluerobotics.com/learn/technical-reference/; 10.3390/jmse10121898; 10.1016/j.oceaneng.2021.109279; local copy of the patched HoloOcean source
parameters.derivation: 12 N is 33 % of the T200 at 12 V and 23 % at 16 V. Four horizontal thrusters at 45 deg give 4 x 12 / sqrt(2) = 33.9 N of surge force at full command (37-40 % of the 85-92 N of a real vehicle) and 13.6 N at the nominal authority 0.40 (about 15 %)
parameters.validity: T200 figures are bench data at fixed voltage. Not modelled: thruster deadzone and about 0.08 s thruster lag. State that the simulated horizontal thrust is about 0.15 (nominal) to 0.4 (full) of a real Heavy

parameters.parameter: AUTHORITY: cap of the normalised horizontal command (nominal / brake / escape)
parameters.source: no external source; controller design inside the simulator control scheme 0 (thruster forces) (R1 section 0)
parameters.derivation: effective force along one axis 0.40 / 0.50 / 0.60 x 33.9 N = 13.6 / 17.0 / 20.4 N
parameters.validity: Bounds the control-feasible envelope (control/current_envelope.py); not a vehicle property

parameters.parameter: HoloOcean engine hydrodynamics (drag coefficient, area, damping)
parameters.source: inherited simulator constants, no cited source. Literature differs widely: von Benzon (pool, tether) quadratic surge damping 141.0 N s^2/m^2; Wu 2018 18.18 (values taken from another vehicle); Gabl 16.4 N measured at 0.6 m/s (R1 2.4)
parameters.doi_or_url: 10.3390/jmse10121898; https://flex.flinders.edu.au/file/27aa0064-9de2-441c-8a17-655405d5fc2e/1/ThesisWu2018.pdf; 10.1016/j.oceaneng.2021.109279; local copy of the patched HoloOcean source
parameters.derivation: surge drag at 0.6 m/s through the water: von Benzon 59.0 N, Wu 9.0 N, Gabl 16.4 N, simulator 11.0 N; the simulator is 0.67 of Gabl and 0.19 of von Benzon
parameters.validity: Isotropic quadratic drag cannot represent the measured anisotropy (141 / 217 / 190 N s^2/m^2 in surge / sway / heave). Call the plant HoloOcean default dynamics calibrated in closed loop, not BlueROV2 hydrodynamics

parameters.parameter: Steady-command curve g(r) = abs(r) / 2.4 + 0.203 r^2 (surge/sway slope, quadratic term, tolerance)
parameters.source: (from simulator calibration, class d) calibration/probe_head_current_authority.py, largest residual 5.3 % (DESIGN_ITERATIONS DI-27)
parameters.derivation: multiplying by 33.9 N gives F_sim(r) = 14.1 r + 6.9 r^2 N; at nominal authority the through-water speed is 0.70-0.71 m/s, not the 0.96 m/s predicted by the small-signal slope
parameters.validity: Valid up to about 0.71 m/s through the water (highest calibrated speed); closed loop with the DVL velocity loop, 0.1 s period and the 12 N limit; not a hardware figure

parameters.parameter: Heave slope
parameters.source: (from simulator calibration, calibration/probe_motion.py) small-signal slope; 48 N per unit heave command
parameters.derivation: feasibility check: vertical bollard thrust of the Heavy 14 kgf (137 N); von Benzon heave limit 0.71 m/s at 120 N
parameters.validity: Feasible for the declared 0.25 m/s vertical current (about 20 N from the von Benzon drag model, 15 % of 137 N)

parameters.parameter: Commanded current to steady drift of an unactuated vehicle (horizontal and vertical tables)
parameters.source: (from simulator calibration, calibration/probe_current.py) HoloOcean applies the current through quadratic drag on the relative velocity; Unreal linear damping acts on the body velocity
parameters.derivation: a commanded 1.0 m/s produces only 0.117 m/s of drift; Envelope current values are effective drifts
parameters.validity: Simulator convention only; same table for the vertical component

parameters.parameter: Closing deceleration per drone
parameters.source: (from simulator calibration, class d) stop from 0.446-0.455 m/s in 0.6 s over 0.098-0.104 m: 0.743-0.758 m/s^2 from the stop time and 0.994-1.021 m/s^2 from the stop distance (R1 2.3)
parameters.derivation: open-loop bound from von Benzon: (13.5 + 6.36 kg) with 85 N reverse force gives 4.3 m/s^2 at zero speed; Gabl 86 N backward with 11.5 + 6.36 kg gives 4.8 m/s^2. a_brake is about 1/9 of the open-loop bound and 0.67 of the simulator figure
parameters.validity: Closed-loop simulator figure (DVL velocity loop, no added mass, 12 N limit); physically conservative; to be re-measured on hardware. No BlueROV2 braking measurement was found in the literature

parameters.parameter: Survey speed
parameters.source: mission design choice; R1 2.1 verdict SUPPORTED as feasible: 42 % of von Benzon's identified surge limit (0.72 m/s) and 20 % of the manufacturer's 1.5 m/s
parameters.derivation: feasibility only; the two capability sources differ by a factor of about 2 (0.72 m/s identified, about 1.4-1.5 m/s manufacturer and Gabl)
parameters.validity: Not a physical constant. The simulator reaches 0.71 m/s through the water at nominal authority

parameters.parameter: Cruise cap outside avoidance and escape speed
parameters.source: design caps; R1 2.2 verdict SUPPORTED as feasible in still water under both capability sources
parameters.derivation: a lateral escape at 0.55 m/s with the residual drift w_drift_max = 0.15 m/s needs up to 0.70 m/s through the water
parameters.validity: 0.70 m/s exceeds von Benzon's identified sway limit (0.63 m/s) but not the capability implied by Gabl's forces: flag lateral escape against a cross current as marginal in a hardware claim

parameters.parameter: Horizontal current exercised
parameters.source: (a) Blue Robotics FAQ: operate in currents no stronger than 1-1.5 knots (0.51-0.77 m/s); (b) Gabl hold force 16.4 N at 0.6 m/s (18 % of 92 N thrust); no site current statistics were opened (R1 3.1)
parameters.derivation: effective drift of an unactuated vehicle (Envelope convention); at the 0.30 m/s survey speed the authority already stops at about 0.41 m/s head current (calibration), 0.60 m/s lateral is held without saturation
parameters.validity: Exercised range, not a controllability bound (DI-27). Do not present simulated loads as real hydrodynamic loads

parameters.parameter: Vertical current declared
parameters.source: no source on vertical current magnitudes was opened (R1 3.2)
parameters.derivation: feasibility only: heave capability 14 kgf vertical bollard thrust; von Benzon drag model gives about 20 N at 0.25 m/s
parameters.validity: Declared, not binding (separate heave channel), no empirical basis

parameters.parameter: DVL geometry and rate (beam elevation, MaxRange, report rate)
parameters.source: (a) Water Linked DVL A50 datasheet v5: 1 MHz, 4-beam Janus, beam angle 22.5 deg, ping rate 4-15 Hz (adaptive), maximum altitude 50 m (above 35 m depends on seabed conditions); TCP JSON report rate 2-15 Hz (R1 4.1)
parameters.derivation: none (values copied)
parameters.validity: Ping rate and bottom lock depend on altitude; a fixed 10 Hz lies inside the published range

parameters.parameter: dvl_vel_sigma (per-beam velocity noise)
parameters.source: (a) Nortek DVL1000: single-ping std 0.8 cm/s at 1.5 m/s; Wayfinder on a BlueROV2 Heavy: 10 mm/s at 1.5 m/s (vendor reprint); 600 kHz Explorer 0.01 m/s (Spielvogel Table VI); A50 publishes no single-ping noise (R1 4.2). Conservative
parameters.derivation: HoloOcean applies VelSigma per beam; body-frame horizontal std = sigma_b / (sqrt(2) sin 22.5 deg) = 1.85 sigma_b, vertical 0.54 sigma_b: LOW 1.85 cm/s, MEDIUM 2.8 cm/s (probe: 0.0184, 0.0188, 0.0054 m/s at 0.01). White noise adds 0.055 m (LOW) and 0.083 m (MEDIUM) to a 90 s dead-reckoning run
parameters.validity: Vendor values are at 1.5 m/s; the vehicles fly at 0.55 m/s or less near the seabed, so the comparison is conservative. Nortek and Wayfinder do not state per-beam or per-component

parameters.parameter: DVL long-term (scale-factor) error
parameters.source: omission (R1 4.3): A50 Standard long-term accuracy +-1.01 %; Nortek license-free above 1 %; Wayfinder scale factor within +-1.15 %. The model has white noise only
parameters.derivation: an along-track error of up to 1 % of the distance travelled (0.3 m over a 30 m approach)
parameters.validity: Open issue O-4. R1 recommends a per-run, per-drone scale factor uniform in +-1 % for LOW and MEDIUM, or an explicit statement of the omission

parameters.parameter: dvl_range_sigma (per-beam range noise)
parameters.source: neither the A50 datasheet nor the docs overview gives an altitude or range accuracy (R1 4.4)
parameters.derivation: small next to seabed_tol_m = 0.70 m
parameters.validity: Label as an assumption

parameters.parameter: DVL dropout per sample and outage windows (bottom-lock loss)

value.outage: MEDIUM only: 1.0 s, mean period 60 s

parameters.source: causes documented qualitatively (altitude, bubbles from thrusters, blocked beams, lock cycling every 10 s in tanks); no frequency or duration statistic for small vehicles was found (R1 4.5)
parameters.derivation: partial-beam windows used in the literature are 5-30 s (Cohen and Klein, their test design), much longer than the 1 s outage
parameters.validity: Keep as stress setting; a single-factor screen with 5-30 s outages would be informative

parameters.parameter: imu_accel_sigma (accelerometer white noise, 30 Hz)
parameters.source: (a) ICM-20602 accelerometer noise 100 ug/sqrt(Hz) (TDK 2019, InvenSense 2015); 3DM-GX5-25 0.0075 m/s^2 at 20 Hz (Spielvogel Table VI). At or above the datasheet (R1 5.2)
parameters.derivation: sigma = 9.81e-4 sqrt(B) m/s^2: 3.8e-3 at 15 Hz bandwidth and 9.8e-3 at 100 Hz; ours is 1.0-2.6x (LOW) and 2.0-5.3x (MEDIUM)
parameters.validity: Used for roll and pitch only. The output filter bandwidth of the real Navigator/ArduSub pipeline is not verified

parameters.parameter: imu_gyro_sigma (gyro white noise, 30 Hz)
parameters.source: (a) ICM-20602 gyro noise 0.004 dps/sqrt(Hz); 3DM-GX5-25 0.00025 rad/s. Very conservative (R1 5.3)
parameters.derivation: 0.004 dps/sqrt(Hz) = 6.98e-5 rad/s/sqrt(Hz): 2.7e-4 rad/s at 15 Hz, 7.0e-4 at 100 Hz; ours is 7-18x (LOW) and 14-37x (MEDIUM)
parameters.validity: Used for yaw-rate damping only. The excess may represent unquantified thruster vibration: label as an upper bound

parameters.parameter: IMU bias random-walk steps (accelerometer, gyro; per 30 Hz sample)
parameters.source: no in-run stability specification was opened; the ICM-20602 datasheet DS-000176 (ZRO tolerance) could not be retrieved (R1 5.4). Order of magnitude of an uncalibrated MEMS offset (Kinsey: 1-5 deg/s); far above a calibrated AHRS (A50 yaw drift 0.1-0.3 deg per minute)
parameters.derivation: bias(T) = sigma_step sqrt(30 T). After 90 s: gyro bias 0.30 deg/s (LOW), 0.89 deg/s (MEDIUM); accel bias 0.010 / 0.026 m/s^2; equivalent tilt error 0.06 / 0.15 deg
parameters.validity: Sample-rate dependent (sigma_step x sqrt(f)). Limited effect: gyro and accelerometer do not enter the horizontal position estimate

parameters.parameter: heading_bias_deg, LOW (constant compass bias, sign from the seed)
parameters.source: (b) best case only: calibrated compasses reach 1-3 deg (Kinsey); MMC5983MA 1.0 deg typical; MAVBE about 1 deg; 0.55 deg after MAGYC in one experiment (R1 6.1)
parameters.derivation: a constant bias b gives a cross-track dead-reckoning error D sin b = 0.87 % of the distance travelled
parameters.validity: Keep only as best-case in-situ calibration. Open issue O-5 (R1: raise to 1.0 deg or label as best case)

parameters.parameter: heading_bias_deg, MEDIUM
parameters.source: (b) properly calibrated magnetic heading 1-3 deg (Kinsey 2.2.1); Rypkema SandShark about 3 deg 1-sigma after calibration; Spielvogel TWOSTEP 2.88 / 2.60 deg; uncalibrated 23-28 deg (R1 6.1)
parameters.derivation: D sin b = 3.49 % of the distance travelled
parameters.validity: Literature values are calibration residuals; real errors also depend on heading (soft iron) and vary with thruster currents. The simulated magnetic vector is horizontal, so tilt-coupled errors are absent. The Rypkema 3 deg is read from the ar5iv rendering, which prints 33 deg (typesetting artefact): confirm in the PDF

parameters.parameter: mag_sigma (magnetometer white noise per axis of a unit field, 30 Hz)
parameters.source: (a) MMC5983MA total RMS noise 0.4-1.2 mG; 3DM-GX5-25 0.002 gauss; VN100 1 mG. Conservative for the chip (R1 6.2)
parameters.derivation: heading std is about 57.3 sigma deg: 0.29 / 0.57 / 1.15 deg per sample (probe: 0.29, 0.56, 1.16)
parameters.validity: Real heading error is dominated by calibration residuals, not chip noise. Heading is atan2(m_y, m_x) of the raw sample (nav.py, no filter)

parameters.parameter: depth_sigma (pressure depth, 30 Hz)
parameters.source: (a) MS5837-30BA resolution 0.20 mbar RMS at OSR 8192 (0.28-1.57 mbar at lower OSR); Bar30 resolution 2 mm; conservative (R1 7)
parameters.derivation: 0.02 m is about 1.96 mbar, 10x the best RMS resolution; 0.03 m about 15x
parameters.validity: The absolute offset (about +-0.5 m at 0-6 bar) is removed by zeroing at the surface and is not modelled; water-density setting and surface waves are not modelled

parameters.parameter: latency_s, transport (all onboard streams)
parameters.source: (a) Water Linked TCP JSON message latency about 4 ms average, 2 ms std, 13 ms observed maximum (R1 9.1). Data are delivered late but stamped with the capture time (sim/holo_env.py)
parameters.derivation: a velocity delay tau offsets the dead-reckoning position by v tau: 0.015 m at 0.05 s (0.30 m/s)
parameters.validity: Supported as transport latency only; see the next two rows for the DVL measurement age and the other streams

parameters.parameter: latency_s, DVL measurement age (time of validity to delivery)
parameters.source: weak evidence, two sources (R1 9.1): von Benzon Table 1 gives a DVL delay of 0.1 s; the Water Linked docs example gives time_of_transmission minus time_of_validity = 0.189 s (one example, not a statistic)
parameters.derivation: v tau at 0.30 m/s: 0.03 m (0.1 s), 0.057 m (0.19 s); adds phase lag to the DVL velocity loop
parameters.validity: Open issue O-3: the code applies one latency to every stream (no separate DVL age). R1 recommends 0.1-0.2 s for the DVL in MEDIUM

parameters.parameter: latency_s, IMU, compass, depth
parameters.source: no latency data found for these streams (R1 9.1); Nortek proprietary format gives 1 ms time-stamp accuracy only
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Keep as assumption

parameters.parameter: Dead-reckoning drift envelope implied by heading bias (cross-track share of distance)
parameters.source: (b) R1 8: 0.2-10 % of the distance travelled in the literature, 2-5 % typical for modestly priced units and 0.1 % for the best INS (Paull); 0.4 % over five-hour missions (Kinsey); 10 % reduced to 0.2-0.5 % with MAGYC; SandShark without a DVL 2-10 %
parameters.derivation: D sin b with b = 0.5 / 2.0 deg; DVL white noise adds less than 0.1 m per run; a missing 1 % scale factor would add up to 1 % along track
parameters.validity: LOW and MEDIUM lie inside the published range. Consistency issue with AcousticConfig.nav_err_gate_m: open issue O-6

parameters.parameter: IMU, compass and depth rates
parameters.source: simulator configuration (R1 section 0); IMU/compass/depth publish rates are not tied to a datasheet
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Output filter bandwidths and stream latencies of the real Navigator/ArduSub pipeline are not verified

parameters.parameter: NoiseProfile HIGH (all fields)
parameters.source: pure stress level beyond the declared operating domain (out-of-envelope checks); not a validation level (sensor_noise.py)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: No provenance is claimed for HIGH values; they are excluded from VALIDATION_LEVELS

parameters.parameter: Sonar suite: six SinglebeamSonar, one per hull face (mount positions)
parameters.source: no source describes a six-face suite of wide single beams on a small ROV; the closest published concept is a nine-beam forward-looking sonar for small AUVs (Morency et al.). R2 1a: design assumption with a derived coverage requirement
parameters.derivation: six cones on the body axes cover the sphere only if the half-angle is at least arccos(1/sqrt(3)) = 54.74 deg (cube-corner directions); margin at 60 deg is 5.26 deg. Mounts = HULL_HALF + 1 cm
parameters.validity: HoloOcean has no acoustic interference between transmitters; 36 co-located sonars pinging at 10 Hz (six drones) would need frequency or code separation on real hardware. Describe the layout as a coverage requirement, not a product

parameters.parameter: Cone opening (full angle, hard-edged in HoloOcean)
parameters.source: R2 1b design assumption: no conical single-beam proximity sonar of comparable width was found. Widest conical single beams: 20-25 deg (Ping 25 deg at -3 dB, Imagenex 852 20 deg with 330 kHz option), 60 deg at -10 dB for a fish-finder transducer; 120-130 deg exists only as the horizontal fan of multibeam imaging sonars
parameters.derivation: directivity index of an ideal uniform cone D = 4 pi / Omega: 6.0 dB at 120 deg versus 19.3 dB at 25 deg, about 13 dB less per pass for the same transducer
parameters.validity: HoloOcean applies a hard cone with uniform sensitivity (probe: detection up to 60 deg off-axis, 62.5 deg at 3 m). Call the sensor an idealised wide-beam range-only sensor, never a commercial device

parameters.parameter: RangeMin
parameters.source: (a) Ping typical minimum range 0.3 m; MicronEchosounder 0.3-50 m; S500 minimum 0.3 m (Imagenex 852: 0.5 m) (R2 1c)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Mapping holds for the minimum range only (blind zone), not for the beamwidth. Hard cut in HoloOcean; hulls at contact distance lie inside the blind zone, safety relies on acting earlier (d_safe 1.0 m)

parameters.parameter: RangeMax
parameters.source: R2 1d design assumption: hard cut-off; narrow-beam products reach 50-100 m on large targets, no source gives a detection range for a BlueROV2-size target with a 120 deg beam
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: HoloOcean bin intensity does not decay with range: detection is 100 % up to RangeMax and 0 beyond (probe: 100 % at 11 m, 0 % at 12.5 m)

parameters.parameter: Range bins (width)
parameters.source: (a) mapped: Ping resolution 0.5 % of scan range gives 6 cm at 12 m; dedicated echosounders resolve 1-20 mm (R2 1e)
parameters.validity: Resolution is not accuracy: no opened single-beam datasheet states a range accuracy

parameters.parameter: Capture rate
parameters.source: (a) S500 maximum 10 pings/s; (b) nine-beam small-AUV prototype pinged about every 0.1 s in field trials; multibeams 5-97 Hz (R2 1f)
parameters.derivation: two-way travel time at 12 m is 24 m / 1480 m/s = 16 ms, compatible with 10 Hz
parameters.validity: Order of magnitude only. Simultaneous pinging of six co-located transducers is not covered by any source

parameters.parameter: Detection threshold (HoloOcean intensity units)
parameters.source: (from simulator measurement, class d, and DI-11) with add 0.05, mult 0.1, range 0.05: false alarms per capture 98 % at 0.15, 6.7 % at 0.20, 0 % at 0.25 and above (60 empty captures); a BlueROV2 at 1-8 m detected in 100 % of captures up to 0.70; target peaks 0.9-1.2 (R2 2a)
parameters.derivation: T / sigma_add = 6.0 / 5.0 / 4.0; per-bin tail exp(-T^2 / (2 sigma^2)) = 1.5e-8 / 3.7e-6 / 3.4e-4
parameters.validity: Intensity is R^2 cos averaged per bin, not a calibrated echo level; noise is stationary, whereas real detectors adapt the threshold to range and environment

parameters.parameter: sonar_add_sigma, CLEAN (Rayleigh scale of the additive intensity noise)
parameters.source: (from simulator measurement, class d) probe fit of the Rayleigh scale 0.0496 for 0.05; exceedances 0 / 1 / 8 / 44 / 296 observed against 0.0 / 1.2 / 10.3 / 45.2 / 283.8 expected for 0.05 / 0.07 / 0.08 / 0.09 / 0.11 (R2 2b)
parameters.derivation: HoloOcean uses AddSigma as the Rayleigh scale (std of each Gaussian component); the std of the added noise is 0.655 AddSigma
parameters.validity: No source ties a HoloOcean intensity sigma to a physical noise level

parameters.parameter: sonar_add_sigma, LOW and MEDIUM
parameters.source: no measured false-alarm rate for small-vehicle sonars was found (R2 2b). The exact Rayleigh formula is optimistic against shallow-water field data, which show heavier tails (Lyons and Abraham; Gallaudet and de Moustier)
parameters.derivation: per capture and sonar (234 bins): 8.7e-4 (LOW), 7.6e-2 (MEDIUM, 4.5 false alarms per drone per second); confirmed 2-of-3 ghosts per drone per second 8.2e-6 (LOW), 0.064 (MEDIUM, one every 16 s)
parameters.validity: Report as T/sigma (5 and 4). The archived anchor (transponder-ranging outlier rates) is a different device and does not support the value. A K or Rayleigh-mixture wrapper would be the literature-backed heavy-tailed option (not implemented)

parameters.parameter: sonar_mult_sigma (normal, multiplicative, per occupied bin)
parameters.source: convention of HoloOcean (ICRA 2022 Eq. 2; IROS 2022 Eq. 12); no value is given for a single-beam echosounder. Effect measured in the probe: peak p05-p95 widens from 0.90-1.20 (0.10) to 0.93-1.52 (0.30); MEDIUM 0.25 was not probed (R2 2c)
parameters.derivation: fade gain 0.2 assumes peaks of at most 1.5 (0.2 x 1.5 = 0.30 = threshold); at MEDIUM the upper tail can approach that
parameters.validity: Minor: a few faded captures may still contain the echo

parameters.parameter: sonar_range_sigma (exponential mean of the per-leaf range diffusion)
parameters.source: HoloOcean model (IROS 2022 Sec. III-D: exponential range diffusion as an approximation of a K-distribution model); no value is given for any device (R2 2d)
parameters.derivation: in code the value is the mean (= std) of a one-sided exponential, one draw per leaf; the leading edge is the minimum over many leaves and barely moves (p95 +0.044 m, max +0.094 m up to 0.40) while the far tail grows like sigma ln N
parameters.validity: Not a standard deviation of the echo edge. MEDIUM 0.10 m versus structure_tol_far_m 0.70: open issue O-2
parameters.code_action: none; open issue O-2 (see structure tolerances)

parameters.parameter: sonar_range_jitter_m, LOW (whole-profile shift, quantised to 5 cm bins)
parameters.source: R2 3b: the archived anchor (Ping resolution 0.5 % of range) is a misread, because the Ping page labels the resolution relative to the waterfall (scan) range and a quantisation step is not a standard deviation; the physical motivation in sensor_noise.py (timing or sound-speed fluctuation) does not fit a range-independent shift
parameters.derivation: shift k = round(N(0, sigma) / 0.05 m) bins (holo_env._degrade); P(k >= 1) = 4.8 %, P(k >= 2) = 2.9e-7 per side
parameters.validity: Consistent with eps_range for hull echoes at LOW (3e-7 per side)

parameters.parameter: sonar_range_jitter_m, MEDIUM
parameters.source: R2 3b: contradicts the declared Envelope. P(k >= 1) = 20.2 %, P(k >= 2) = 6.2e-3 per side; with the measured hull baselines (+0.044 / +0.054 m far side, -0.006 m near side) k = +2 gives +0.144 to +0.154 m against eps_range_far = 0.12 m and k = -2 gives -0.106 m against -0.08 m
parameters.derivation: about 1.2 % of MEDIUM captures (0.62 % per side) violate eps_range for hull echoes
parameters.validity: Open issue O-1. Values unchanged (checked): holo_env._degrade shifts by any k, no truncation at +-1 bin; Envelope.eps_range unchanged. The exceedance is now declared in the sensor_noise.py docstring and in the eps_range_far comment (stress level, outside the proved P1 envelope)
parameters.code_action: changed: exceedance declared in code comments; values unchanged; open issue O-1

parameters.parameter: sonar_dropout (capture lost, per capture and sonar)
parameters.source: no source found for small-vehicle sonar capture loss (R2 3c)
parameters.derivation: one lost capture gives age 0.1 s + latency; two consecutive losses (1e-4 at 1 %) reach 0.25 s with the MEDIUM latency 0.05 s, the boundary of age <= tau_max (R2 convention, see O-7)
parameters.validity: Stress setting

parameters.parameter: sonar_fade_prob and sonar_fade_gain (missed detection: the capture arrives, the target echo does not)
parameters.source: the archived anchor (Kaeli et al. 2019, 10 % no-return in a simulation) concerns transponder ranging, not echo detection, and its numbers were not re-verified (R2 3d). Real misses depend on range, target strength and SNR, which HoloOcean does not model
parameters.derivation: the 2-of-3 confirmation loses a target when two of the last three captures fade: 3.0e-4 (1 %), 2.7e-3 (3 %)
parameters.validity: The sector stays healthy and its silence would be trusted: the hazardous case. Code action: EchoHold (commit 31efb0d, perception/targets.py) holds the nearest obstacle echo of every healthy sector for tau_max, so a single missed capture becomes a stale reading; consecutive misses longer than tau_max stay outside the declared envelope

parameters.parameter: Whole-drone sonar blackout (MEDIUM)
parameters.source: no source (R2 3e); duty 0.25 %, one or two captures of all six sonars lost
parameters.derivation: the data age reaches 0.30 s (0.15 s before the next capture plus the 0.15 s blackout, R1 9.2), above tau_max by design
parameters.validity: Exercises FAILSAFE (a sector older than tau_max is unhealthy, sense_ok is false). MEDIUM only

parameters.parameter: OCTREE_LEAF_M (sonar octree leaf; cone-edge resolution)
parameters.source: simulator setting (holoocean_setup.OCTREE_MIN); the engine sets ShadowEpsilon to OctreeMin for SinglebeamSonar when it is not set (R2 section B)
parameters.derivation: angular size of one leaf at range r = atan2(0.06, r)
parameters.validity: Enters the detection-cone margin of distance_bound.py

parameters.parameter: NEAR_FIELD_WIDEN_M (near-field widening of the structure window)
parameters.source: (from simulator measurement, DI-12) at 0.63 m the FRONT sonar returned a gate post 78 deg off its axis, 18 deg outside the nominal 60 deg cone
parameters.derivation: widening angle atan(0.25 m / r): 22 deg at 0.6 m, 5 deg at 3 m, 2 deg at 7 m
parameters.validity: Changes the prediction of where mapped structure can echo, not the decision thresholds

parameters.parameter: MAX_REL_TILT_DEG (tilt of another hull relative to the observer body frame)
parameters.source: assumption: BlueROV2-class vehicles are passively stable in roll and pitch; the bound is checked on the logs (distance_bound.py)
parameters.derivation: level cylinders inside the hull box for any heading and tilt up to this value (HULL_CYLINDERS)
parameters.validity: Role of the tilt assumption is exercised by formal S0 (hull attitude sweep)

parameters.parameter: Region-lattice constants (N_DIRS, COVER_RAD, RADII grid, SAMPLING_ERR, RHO_MIN)
parameters.source: (from numerical measurement) covering radius of the lattice measured 0.0139 rad (tests/test_distance_bound.py); sampling error = lattice covering radius 0.023 rad + boundary shift between consecutive grid radii 0.02 rad
parameters.derivation: certification margin gamma(rho) = (covering radius + region shift) x parallax amplification; RHO_MIN = d_safe
parameters.validity: Numerical discretisation of the region tables; certifications hold only with this margin

parameters.parameter: structure_tol_m and structure_tol_far_m (echo explained by the gate map)
parameters.source: (from the sonar noise model, DI-14) exponential range noise acts per octree leaf: the farthest of about 10^3 leaves lies about 0.05 ln N = 0.4 m beyond the surface, so structure echoes are lengthened on the far side only
parameters.derivation: R2 2d: at MEDIUM range_sigma 0.10 the expected maximum over N = 100 / 300 / 1000 leaves is 0.52 / 0.63 / 0.75 m, and P(at least one leaf beyond 0.70 m) = 0.09 / 0.24 / 0.60 per capture (8e-5 to 8e-4 at 0.05)
parameters.validity: Open issue O-2: a segment whose last bin passes sw[1] + 0.70 fails in_struct (sonar_processing.py:185) and becomes UNKNOWN or DYNAMIC at the structure's own range. Not verified on logs; cheap check: replay logged MEDIUM profiles with the tolerance scaled to range_sigma

parameters.parameter: seabed_tol_m
parameters.source: bench observation noted in the code comment: kelp up to about 0.6 m above the DVL bottom (rough, vegetated seabed); no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Large against dvl_range_sigma 0.02-0.05 m

parameters.parameter: Classifier and tracker constants (merge gap, vehicle extent, confirmation, track drop, closing-rate filter)
parameters.source: design constants of the onboard classifier; no external source (DI-11, DI-14, DI-15 give the reasoning for the persistence rule)
parameters.derivation: confirmation 2 of 3 trades false alarms (7.6e-2 per capture at MEDIUM) against missed targets (fade, see above)
parameters.validity: Persistence costs no safety for hulls in the CR because they are seen for several captures before the bars mask them (formal M4d)

parameters.parameter: d_collision (ground-truth centre distance at hull contact, referee only)
parameters.source: (from HULL_HALF) side-by-side hull boxes touch at 2 x 0.288 = 0.576 m (computed here); the code comment says BlueROV2 hulls touch around this distance
parameters.derivation: 2 x HULL_HALF[1] rounded up
parameters.validity: Never read by a controller

parameters.parameter: d_safe (P1 requirement G(d >= d_safe))
parameters.source: safety requirement chosen by the project; no external source
parameters.derivation: equals sonar_geometry.RHO_MIN (region tables start at d_safe)
parameters.validity: Ground-truth distance, referee only; the guards compare the conservative onboard distance with d_ca and d_warning

parameters.parameter: d_warning
parameters.source: (from formal check S1b/S1c) smallest d_warning verified by BMC bisection and k-induction = 1.840 m; configured 2.4 m (margin 0.56 m keeps escapes rare: liveness); mutation d_warning = 1.59 must violate P1 (SAT)
parameters.derivation: pairwise radial model with c_max = 1.20 m/s, a_pair = 2 a_brake, d_hat <= d (S0)
parameters.validity: Valid under the assumptions listed in check_separation.py (detection inside the 60 deg cone, a_brake, w_rel_max, velocity caps)

parameters.parameter: d_warning_exit, d_ca, d_ca_exit, d_nominal
parameters.source: hysteresis and trigger levels chosen by the project. config.py states that d_ca is the smallest proven value plus a margin; formal/results/separation.json reports the smallest verified d_warning only (1.840 m)
parameters.derivation: d_nominal = smallest inter-slot distance of every formation template; d_warning_exit - d_warning = 0.3 m
parameters.validity: Ordering d_nominal > d_warning_exit > d_warning > d_ca_exit > d_ca > d_safe > d_collision holds for these values

parameters.parameter: dt (controller period)
parameters.source: equal to the 10 Hz capture period of the sonar and the DVL; no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: tau_max (maximum age of the sonar data used by a guard)
parameters.source: (from design: 10 Hz capture period + one dropped capture + margin) measured maximum age 0.0 s on the CLEAN reference runs (results/reference/ASSUMPTIONS.md, A2) (R1 9.2, R2 3f)
parameters.derivation: with the MEDIUM latency 0.05 s the data age just before the next capture is 0.15 s and one dropped capture reaches exactly 0.25 s (R1); R2 reaches the same boundary after two consecutive drops (1e-4 at 1 %), counting a fresh capture as age 0 (ASSUMPTIONS.md A2): the reports differ by one capture in the age convention
parameters.validity: Open issue O-7: MEDIUM has zero margin on tau_max; a MEDIUM blackout (0.15 s) exceeds it by design

parameters.parameter: eps_range_far and eps_range_near (echo may lie this much farther or nearer than the true near surface)
parameters.source: (from simulator measurement, class d, R2 3a) Phase 1 noise off: error +0.004 to +0.054 m (BlueROV2 head-on), +0.013 broadside, +0.025 box, -0.015 pillar, +0.035 top bar, -0.037 to -0.001 gate opening; CLEAN noise a stable +0.054 m; noise probe max +0.094 m at MultSigma 0.30 or RangeSigma 0.40, +0.144 m at MultSigma 0.60. No external anchor
parameters.derivation: the value matches the measured maxima (0.054 plus margin). An earlier comment in config.py decomposed 0.12 as one 5 cm bin + 6 cm leaf + 5 cm threshold bias, which sums to 0.16 m (R2 3a); the comment now states the measured maximum plus margin
parameters.validity: HoloOcean 2.3.0 only (leaf 0.06 m, 5 cm bins, threshold 0.30, CLEAN or LOW engine noise). Real deployments add a sound-speed scale term abs(dc/c) x r. MEDIUM jitter exceeds both values (O-1); the comment of eps_range_far now records this (about 0.6 % of captures per side)
parameters.code_action: changed: comment corrected and MEDIUM exceedance recorded; values unchanged; open issue O-1

parameters.parameter: w_rel_max and w_drift_max (unrejected residual drift)
parameters.source: (from simulator calibration, R1 3.1) station-keeping lateral residual drift 0.034 m/s at 0.60 m/s current and 0.158 m/s at 0.80 m/s
parameters.derivation: residuals after the low-level loop has compensated the current
parameters.validity: Hold only while the requested velocity is control-feasible against the raw current (control/current_envelope.py); persistent saturation violates them and the onboard monitor declares ENVELOPE_VIOLATION (DI-24, DI-27)

parameters.parameter: g_min and v_open (certified escape opening, warning-filter opening)
parameters.source: design requirements; checked by formal S2a (worst certified guarantee 0.511) and S2b (worst certified opening 0.202 m/s)
parameters.derivation: sampling error of the direction tables (0.045) already subtracted
parameters.validity: Exhaustive over the 26 sector patterns

parameters.parameter: struct_keepout
parameters.source: never close on mapped structure nearer than this; no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: Operating depth band (world z, up positive)
parameters.source: scenario design; no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Also used by the acoustic depth check (AcousticConfig.depth_tol_m)

parameters.parameter: c_max (worst-case pair closing speed) and v_close_staleness
parameters.source: (from Envelope) c_max = v_escape + v_max_nominal + w_rel_max = 0.55 + 0.50 + 0.15; v_close_staleness is set equal to it
parameters.derivation: one drone escaping, one cruising, plus differential drift
parameters.validity: Measured back on the reference runs: A3 maximum closing speed 0.794 m/s (results/reference/ASSUMPTIONS.md)

parameters.parameter: Critical region (CR) along-axis planes (entry cr_s_min, exit cr_s_max)
parameters.module: holo_fleet/config.py:GateRule.cr_s_min, cr_s_max (cr_half_len, cr_center_s, cr_lo, cr_hi, in_cr derived)
parameters.source: (from the gate and hull geometry, agreed with the project supervisor) the CR covers the approach immediately before the gate and the gate passage itself, not a region after the gate. The G06 bars are 0.30 m deep along the axis (holo_fleet/arena_bridge.py GATE_BAR_SECTION_M), so a hull touches the frame only while its centre is within 0.15 + R_OUT (|HULL_HALF| = 0.389 m, holo_fleet/perception/sonar_geometry.py) = 0.54 m of the gate plane, any heading
parameters.derivation: cr_s_max = 0.55 >= 0.15 + 0.389 (the whole passage [-0.54, 0.54] inside); cr_s_min = cr_s_max - 1.6 = -1.05: the previous CR length (1.6 m, the symmetric |s| <= 0.8) and volume are kept, so the monitored region is not shrunk; the previous pre-gate part [-0.8, 0] is inside, only the post-passage part (0.55, 0.8] is dropped (tests/test_cr_geometry.py)
parameters.validity: Gate frame: s along the axis towards the exit, l left, z up; the referee's P2 occupancy (GateRule.in_cr) and every onboard and formal use of the CR share this box

parameters.parameter: Critical region (CR) half extents (width, height)
parameters.source: protocol geometry chosen by the project; the code states no derivation. The half-width equals half of the 2.0 m opening quoted in structure_aiding.py
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Gate frame: s along the axis towards the exit, l left, z up; the along-axis extent is in the CR planes row

parameters.parameter: queue_spacing
parameters.source: chosen to satisfy a derived inequality (code comment): larger than d_warning_exit + estimate margin, so queued neighbours never trigger the warning
parameters.derivation: 3.5 m > 2.7 m + margin; equals d_nominal
parameters.validity: Measured back: closest pair of queued drones 3.447-3.510 m on the reference runs (ASSUMPTIONS.md A4; formal M4c needs spacing - 2 x 0.10 m)

parameters.parameter: queue_cone_deg
parameters.source: (from sonar geometry) CR bearing from every queue sonar must stay inside the sonar half-angle
parameters.derivation: 49 + heading_tol 6 + hull fuzz 5 = 60 deg = SonarModel.half_angle_deg
parameters.validity: Formal M4a (queue line); mutation M4m (queue line at s = -4 m) must violate it

parameters.parameter: queue_tol and heading_tol_deg
parameters.source: tolerances chosen by the project; no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Enter the sector-rule tolerance box of the formal precedence checks (M2)

parameters.parameter: hold_err_m (position-holding error of a queued drone)
parameters.source: (from simulator measurement) the code comment cites results/reference/ASSUMPTIONS.md (A4: queued neighbours at least spacing - 2 x 0.10 m apart)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Simulator figure (CLEAN, DVL velocity loop)

parameters.parameter: Approach zone and bracket (approach_len, corridor_half_width, queue_bracket_m)
parameters.source: geometry chosen by the project (DI-23 for the outer queue points of n >= 5); no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: queue_bracket_m equals FormationRule.neighbour_range_m

parameters.parameter: t_clear and t_occ_max
parameters.source: protocol timers chosen by the project. t_occ_max is a fallback: the CR belief returns FREE after it without corridor echoes (logged as a timeout)
parameters.derivation: safe only if a healthy occupant crosses the CR within t_occ_max (formal M3, crossing speed >= V_LO = 0.12 m/s; measured minimum 0.478-0.487 m/s, ASSUMPTIONS.md A5)
parameters.validity: A drone stopped inside the CR by a fault and masked by the bars is outside the guarantee (formal M3f counterexample). Variant B2 does not release the CR by this fallback while a fresh accepted acoustic fix places a drone possibly inside it (acoustic_gate.heard_inside)

parameters.parameter: Pass-path geometry and speeds
parameters.source: pass-path design (DI-17, DI-28); no external source
parameters.derivation: v_approach = v_pass = Envelope.v_max_nominal
parameters.validity: Pass-path clearance and stacked-queue geometry are checked by formal M4s

parameters.parameter: stack_column_spacing and stack_spacing
parameters.source: chosen so that a diagonal neighbour is always seen in LEFT/RIGHT and a neighbour of the same column only in UP/DOWN (code comment)
parameters.derivation: formal M2v / M2vm: columns 3.5 m apart make a diagonal pair ambiguous, so the columns are farther apart than the stack spacing
parameters.validity: Every pair stays inside the queue bracket

parameters.parameter: queue_lateral_max (validated gate domain)
parameters.source: (from formal M4g) queue points from which a sonar exit witness of every passing drone exists: the abreast queue of 2, the 2 x 2 and 3-drone stacks; beyond it (abreast 4-6, a 3-column stack) the outer drones see no exit and mission.check_gate_domain refuses the passage. With the CR s in [-1.05, 0.55] the queue line of 3 moved 0.25 m back and the outer drones of the abreast queue of 3 (templates triangle, line3) see a passer on the axis only 0.2 s within the 10 m detection range (1.2 s before): a declared limit of B0 (M4g declared limit), whose latch falls back to the t_occ_max timeout (progress, not safety); B2-M4g n=3 gives the acoustic exit evidence there
parameters.derivation: measured detection range used by M4g: R_DETECT_M = 10 m (at least 29 % of captures up to 10 m, 19 % at 10-11 m, 7 % at 11-12 m; results/calibration/gate/exit_detection.json)
parameters.validity: Recent change; the audit reports do not cover the gate parameters. For variant B2, formal B2-M4g reports that with the multipath-covering envelope no acoustic exit evidence exists inside this domain: the sonar latch applies (see ACOUSTIC_CHANNEL_MODEL.md section 9)
parameters.code_action: recent change: queue_lateral_max introduced (formal M4g, mission.check_gate_domain)

parameters.parameter: MAX_CORR_M (largest horizontal correction of the structure aiding)
parameters.source: the drift a run can accumulate (code comment); no external source
parameters.derivation: a 2 deg bias drifts 3.49 % of the distance; the docstring quotes about 0.5 m after the approach to the gate
parameters.validity: A drone whose drift brought it in front of a bar cannot be relocalised by a range-only fit without an assumption on echo identity: it holds (documented C5 limitation)

parameters.parameter: acquisition_distance (farthest distance before the gate plane at which a fit can be accepted)
parameters.source: (from sonar geometry) a side cone sees a bar point at offset c from the gate axis only when x <= tan(half_angle) abs(c - e); over true offsets abs(e) <= MAX_CORR_M
parameters.derivation: tan(60 deg) x (outer half-extent 1.25 m + MAX_CORR_M 1.2 m) = 4.24 m, with outer = 1.0 m half-opening + 0.25 m bar; capped by SonarModel.range_max
parameters.validity: Gate with a 2.0 m opening and 0.25 m bars; the code evaluates it from the gate map. Recent change (C5: derived from sonar visibility); the audit reports do not cover it

parameters.parameter: Fit acceptance constants of the structure aiding
parameters.source: design constants; validated against the CLEAN runs: the nominal cone predicts the first echo of the horizontal sonars within 0.023-0.026 m (SD) and a bar that is not seen in 0-2 % of the samples (structure_aiding.py)
parameters.derivation: HULL_LAT_M = 0.288 + 0.229 sin 5 deg = 0.308 m (computed from HULL_HALF)
