parameters.parameter: S2h horizon (bounded check of the status model)
parameters.source: verification horizon of a bounded model check: how long a crossing drone may stop before the CR in the model. It is not a delivery deadline of claims and is not used by any monitor since the review of 2026-11-17 (the premise C audit is ordered by events, `referee/premise_audit.py`)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: beyond it S2hs gives the counterexample of a stop behind the bars with no claim heard (n=4 outer queue point; for the n=3 side view the masked region now starts inside the CR, so a stop before the CR is always seen there)

parameters.parameter: FAIR (fairness window of the fixes, premise of the fleet model)
parameters.source: premise of formal/check_fleet.py: within every FAIR seconds there is one instant at which every live drone has a fresh fix of every other live drone at every receiver. When it was introduced (commit 33e59aa, 2026-11-13) the value was set as the longest such gap measured in one scenario of a pre-v11 run set (26 s), rounded up; those runs are not re-examined here and are not evidence for v11
parameters.doi_or_url: formal/check_fleet.py; holo_fleet/referee/robustness_metrics.py; archive v13-final-v11-2026-11-18 (final validation, seeds 8000-8001), run_metrics.json -> fairness
parameters.derivation: FAIR = ceil(35 / 5) = 7 steps. The recovery bounds of F2 (K = 26 / 40 / 52 steps for n = 2 / 3 / 4) and F2p are proved under this window; F2f shows that without it recovery is not guaranteed. With the monitor's freshness limit status_fresh_s = 2.5 s, the premise bounds every live link's silence by FAIR + status_fresh_s = 37.5 s, below t_silent_s = 45 s and t_silent_gate_s = 70 s
parameters.validity: Monitored per run on the logged gate.silence (fairness_gap). In the 34-run final validation (archive v13-final-v11-2026-11-18 (final validation, seeds 8000-8001)): holds in every gate scenario with a logged beacon (B2 MEDIUM gate_four 10.9 / 26.3 s, gate_single 7.9 / 9.6 s, integrated_short 5.3 / 11.3 s, lost_drone_mutex 4.6 / 7.2 s, lost_drone_rejoin 7.1 / 6.1 s, mutex_deadlock_resolution 7.3 / 6.0 s; B2 latency sweep 1.8-3.8 s); not logged in B0 and in p1_head_on (no beacon or no gate); VIOLATED in B2 MEDIUM formation_six (92.7 s, both seeds: six drones, 30 links, no gate), which is outside the fleet model (n = 2-4 at a gate). Simulator channel only; no field evidence. The two literals 35.0 (formal model and monitor) are equal but not tied to one constant

evidence.simulator_calibration: per-run monitor values of the final validation listed under validity (largest in a gate scenario 26.3 s, gate_four s8001; violated only in formation_six, 92.7 s); the original 26 s measurement belongs to a pre-v11 run set and is not used here
evidence.mathematical_derivation: FAIR steps = ceil(35 / DT); silence of a live link <= FAIR + status_fresh_s = 37.5 s under the premise; F2 bounds proved at FAIR = 7
evidence.engineering_design_choice: the value 35 s (round number above the gap measured when the model was built)
evidence.operating_assumption: the acoustic channel delivers, within every 35 s, an instant at which all links of a fleet of 2-4 drones near a gate are fresh (premise V and the channel model); assumed, not guaranteed by any onboard mechanism

parameters.parameter: stage2_hold_s (stage-2 hold of a committed drone before admission, gate frame s on the axis)
parameters.source: (from the declared bounds) the nearest point where holding is P2-safe under the declared gate-frame navigation error, minus the measured holding error; replaces the v11 hold at -(0.8 + HULL_HALF[0] + 0.15) = -1.179 m (with the former symmetric CR |s| <= 0.8), where an estimate 1 m short puts the centre at s = -0.179 m, inside the CR (formal P2Bm)
parameters.derivation: hold_s = cr_s_min - (nav_err_m + w_drift_max * tau_c + e_track + SLACK_M) = -(1.05 + 1.0 + 0.0525 + 0.30 + 0.05) = -2.4525 m; target = hold_s - hold_err_m = -2.5525 m (tests/test_hold_point.py keeps it equal to the derivation); -2.3025 m with the former CR
parameters.validity: Holds while the navigation premise |e_h| <= nav_err_m and the drift bound w_drift_max hold; the CR occupancy is the centre definition of P2. Localization acquisition from it (synthetic B0 scan, bar echoes only): bias (estimate - truth) along the axis -1.0 to 0.0 m and +0.2, +0.3 m acquired, +0.1 m and >= +0.4 m not (bounded hold, then give-up); with the former -2.30 m hold -1.0 to +0.3 and +0.5, +0.6 m: tests/test_hold_point.py

parameters.parameter: hold_lateral_allow (lateral allowance of the stage-2 hold in the queue clearance bound)
parameters.source: (from the declared drift) the steady lateral deviation of the hold loop against the declared residual drift, w_drift_max / k_track = 0.25 m, plus 0.02 m; the acquisition offsets at the hold are vertical (flows.ACQ_OFFSETS)
parameters.derivation: 0.15 / 0.6 + 0.02 = 0.27 m (tests/test_hold_point.py measures the deviation in closed loop)
parameters.validity: Bound (c) of queue_s: with two or more columns every queue point keeps merge_clearance from the hold within this allowance (formal Q1)

parameters.parameter: queue_s bounds (c) hold clearance and (d) queue not ahead of the hold
parameters.source: (from the geometry) (c) a drone held at the stage-2 hold keeps merge_clearance (3.2 m, the criterion of bound (b)) from every other queue point, so a queued drone and a held drone are not in each other's warning band; (d) a queued drone holds where holding is P2-safe
parameters.derivation: (c) queue_s <= stage2_hold_s - sqrt(merge_clearance^2 - max(|l_q| - hold_lateral_allow, 0)^2) for each column lateral l_q when there are >= 2 columns; (d) queue_s <= stage2_hold_s. Every bound follows the CR entry plane cr_s_min (bound (a) is measured from it). v11 lines with the present CR: n1 -2.159, n2 -4.431, n3 -5.656, n4 -6.882 (with the former CR: n1 -1.909, n2 -4.181, n3 -5.406, n4 -6.632)
parameters.validity: Formal Q1 (deployed conservative distance >= d_warning from the hold to every queue point; the n = 3 centre point has the thinnest margin, 2.43 against 2.4) and the mutation Q1m (the v11 n = 2 line fails)

parameters.parameter: P2 filter backup bounds (tau_c, e_track, K_HOLD, SLACK_M, v_err)
parameters.source: (from FleetConfig) tau_c = Envelope.dt + Envelope.tau_max (one control period and the largest data age); e_track = w_drift_max / K_HOLD, the steady deviation of a first-order position loop against the declared residual drift, K_HOLD the smallest hold gain of the flows; the vertical error is taken equal to nav_err_m (more than the depth envelope); v_err = the DVL 3-sigma velocity noise while the DVL is fresh, the speed bound during an outage
parameters.derivation: backup of a command: applied for tau_c (an increase reached at once, a decrease at >= a_brake), braking at a_brake, then station keeping with deviation <= e_track; drift w_drift_max in any direction; robust margin = min(one-step margin, margin of braking after dt from the worst-case state)
parameters.validity: An abstraction of the vehicle: a first-order hold loop and the declared a_brake / w_drift_max (formal P2B1, P2B1r, P2B3 numeric soundness; P2B2s: strict invariance of the one-step margin fails, hence the robust margin and the latched station keeping)

parameters.parameter: ACTIVE_RANGE_M (range of the P2 filter around the critical region)
parameters.source: chosen by the project: beyond it no command of one control step can reach the CR
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Inside it the gate-aware selection engages only when the CR removes candidates; otherwise the P1 planner of the proofs runs unchanged

parameters.parameter: ACQ_OFFSETS and ACQ_PERIOD_S (localization acquisition pattern at the stage-2 hold)
parameters.source: chosen by the project from the synthetic acquisition scan (real StructureAiding, bar echoes only): vertical offsets let the up / down sonars see the frame from farther than on the axis; vertical only, so the queue clearance (c) is unchanged
parameters.derivation: six offsets x 4 s = 24 s, within t_occ_max + t_clear = 26 s
parameters.validity: Idealised bar echoes (no seabed, no other hulls); HoloOcean behaviour in results/gate_safety_v1

parameters.parameter: STANDOFF_MARGIN_M and STANDOFF_ZONE_M (a committed drone stops behind a drone ahead in the corridor)
parameters.source: chosen by the project: the follower stops at d_warning_exit + 0.5 m (conservative distance) from a DYNAMIC echo in its FRONT sector, only farther than 1.5 m behind the hold (an unexplained bar echo near the gate must not stop it out of the acquisition region); the standoff is anchored and runs the stage-2 timer
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Prevention of a rear approach to a held drone; liveness cost measured in formal/results/f1p_kinematic.json

parameters.parameter: Formation error thresholds (e_lost, e_ok, t_ok_hold; same values in RefereeConfig)
parameters.source: thresholds chosen by the project; no external source
parameters.derivation: formal F3: the ball abs(e) <= e* is invariant with e* = 0.44 m along and 0.36 m lateral, below e_ok
parameters.validity: A4 needs the onboard form_err below e_ok

parameters.parameter: Slot-tracking and sonar-correction gains
parameters.source: controller gains; no external source
parameters.derivation: ranking decreases certified in the saturated and linear bands (formal F1, F2); mutations k_slot = 0 and no catch-up margin are caught
parameters.validity: Abstraction of the deployed formation law under explicit fairness and environment assumptions (check_formation.py)

parameters.parameter: Speed caps while following and recovering
parameters.source: design caps; v_recovery_max equals Envelope.v_max_nominal
parameters.derivation: catch-up margin v_recovery_max - v_nominal = 0.2 m/s
parameters.validity: Deliverable against head currents only up to about 0.21 m/s at 0.5 m/s (DI-27)

parameters.parameter: Association, range and re-inclusion constants
parameters.source: design constants; no external source
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: neighbour_range_m equals GateRule.queue_bracket_m and enters t_rejoin

parameters.parameter: v_wait and a_wait (reduced progress while a neighbour is missing)
parameters.source: compromise argued in DI-31 and the config.py comment: catch-up of a rejoining drone grows from 0.20 to 0.30 m/s; the along-track offset between drones noticing an absence at different times grows at v_nominal - v_wait = 0.10 m/s, so a detection spread of 7 s stays below e_ok after the ramp (0.10 x (7 - T_ramp / 2) = 0.45 m)
parameters.derivation: a_wait ramps 0.30 to 0.20 m/s in 5 s, far below the braking capability a_brake
parameters.validity: Never zero: the fleet keeps surveying and keeps steerage

parameters.parameter: t_rejoin (derived) with t_rejoin_margin and t_rejoin_max
parameters.source: (from the catch-up speed) t_rejoin = min(60, neighbour_range_m / (v_recovery_max - v_wait) + margin) = min(60, 7.5 / 0.30 + 5.0) = 30 s
parameters.derivation: the gap is a configured bound, not an onboard estimate; the margin covers ramp-in (about 0.8 s), confirmation (up to 1 s) and the final approach (about 1.5 s), rounded up
parameters.validity: Formal F6 (BMC over ceil(t_rejoin / dt) + 1 steps) and F6r (ranking): a neighbour that never reappears is declared vacant and the drone leaves FORMATION_WAIT_REJOIN

parameters.parameter: t_silent_s (vacancy by silence with the B2 beacon)
parameters.source: with the beacon active a slot is vacant exactly when its drone has not been heard for t_silent_s (perception.py, total-failure model: a broken drone stops transmitting). The comment that introduced the value (commit f50260a, 2026-11-09) cited the longest silence between two drones observed in a pre-v11 MEDIUM run set (31 s); those runs are not re-examined here
parameters.doi_or_url: holo_fleet/perception/acoustic.py; holo_fleet/referee/p3.py; formal/check_fleet.py; archive v13-final-v11-2026-11-18 (final validation, seeds 8000-8001), drone_*_state.jsonl.gz -> gate.silence
parameters.derivation: lower bound: under the fairness premise a live link is silent for at most FAIR + status_fresh_s = 35 + 2.5 = 37.5 s, so 45 s leaves 7.5 s. Ordering kept by the fleet model: T_VAC = ceil(45 / 5) = 9 steps < T_DEAD = 14 steps (vacancy before death). The P3 deadline of a vacancy is t_f + t_silent_s + 2 s (referee/p3.py). Under the stress channel MEDIUM_HT (link outages Pareto, minimum 6 s, alpha 1.2) P(outage >= 45 s) = (6 / 45)^1.2 = 0.089 per outage, and the 60 s bursts of the communication sweep exceed 45 s, so false vacancies are expected there by construction
parameters.validity: B2 only (B0 uses t_rejoin). Longest silence of a live sender at any receiver in the B2 runs of the final validation, computed read-only from the logged gate.silence (same tracker as the vacancy rule): 32.2 s (formation_six s8000), 22.5 s (formation_six s8001), at most 17.2 s in the gate scenarios (gate_four s8001); every B2 run of that validation is PASS. A false vacancy degrades P3 (the live drone is no longer waited for) but releases no gate claim. Simulator channel model only (independent losses per reception, with bursts at MEDIUM); not validated on hardware

evidence.simulator_calibration: final validation: longest live-sender silence 32.2 s (all B2 runs), 17.2 s (gate scenarios), margin 12.8 s to 45 s; the 31 s figure of the original comment is pre-v11 and not used
evidence.mathematical_derivation: 45 > FAIR + status_fresh_s = 37.5 s; T_VAC 9 < T_DEAD 14 steps; MEDIUM_HT tail (6 / 45)^1.2 = 0.089
evidence.engineering_design_choice: 45 s: long enough not to declare a live drone vacant on the MEDIUM channel, short enough that the fleet stops waiting for a dead drone within one minute
evidence.operating_assumption: a live drone is heard by every receiver at least once every 45 s (otherwise a false vacancy, a P3 consequence only)

parameters.parameter: W_RES (residual disturbance after the low-level integrator has converged, premise A2 of the P3 ranking functions)
parameters.source: operating assumption A2 of formal/check_formation.py: after a perturbation the unrejected disturbance is |w| <= w_res, which can hold only while the commanded velocity is control-feasible (A1, control/current_envelope.py). Compared with the closed-loop calibration results/calibration/head_current_authority.json (calibration/probe_head_current_authority.py, authority 0.40, survey speed 0.30 m/s, means over 14-32 s): along-track deficit -0.001 to +0.003 m/s for unsaturated head currents of 0.30-0.40 m/s, +0.037 m/s at 0.45 m/s (91 % saturated) and +0.089 / +0.198 m/s at 0.50 / 0.60 m/s (saturated, outside the envelope); cross-track mean ground velocity 0.033 m/s under a 0.60 m/s lateral current. The station-keeping residuals of R1 3.1 (0.034 m/s at 0.60 m/s, 0.158 m/s at 0.80 m/s) are recorded in the w_rel_max row
parameters.derivation: the along-track ranking margin of F1 is V - v_clock - s_rate - w_res = 0.50 - 0.30 - (0.08 x 1.2 + 0.02 x 2.0) - 0.05 = 0.014 m/s (formal/results/formation.json, eps_far 0.0140 m/s), so F1 fails for w_res >= 0.064 m/s; the ball e* = (s_rate + w_res) / k_slot x 1.05 + 0.005 = 0.439 m must stay below e_ok = 0.5 m (w_res < 0.076 m/s). The binding limit is 0.064 m/s: the assumed 0.05 m/s leaves 0.014 m/s
parameters.validity: The measured values are window means of steady uniform currents on one simulated vehicle at the survey speed; they do not bound the instantaneous |w| that the abstraction assumes at every step, they do not cover the recovery speed 0.50 m/s, oscillating or vertical currents, gusts or the transient before the integrator converges, and the lateral value (0.033 m/s at 0.60 m/s) uses two thirds of the budget. No field or tank measurement. P3 is therefore proved conditionally on A2; A2 itself is an assumption, not a validated property

evidence.simulator_calibration: results/calibration/head_current_authority.json: |along deficit| <= 0.003 m/s unsaturated (head 0.30-0.40 m/s), 0.037 m/s at 0.45 m/s (saturated 91 %); lateral residual 0.033 m/s at 0.60 m/s; window means at 0.30 m/s
evidence.mathematical_derivation: F1 along margin 0.014 m/s; F1 holds for w_res < 0.064 m/s, F3 ball below e_ok for w_res < 0.076 m/s
evidence.engineering_design_choice: 0.05 m/s: above the unsaturated residuals measured in the calibration, below the 0.064 m/s at which the F1 margin vanishes
evidence.operating_assumption: A2: inside the control-feasible envelope and after convergence, the residual disturbance stays within 0.05 m/s at every step, at every speed the formation law commands

parameters.parameter: follow_on_m, follow_off_m, a_follow (spacing to the drone ahead)
parameters.source: code comment: follow_on lies above the calm-flight residual (one 5 cm range bin); a_follow = 2.5 a_wait keeps the compression below about 0.14 m when the drone ahead slows at a_wait
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Prevents a rear drone at the survey speed from closing on a slowed one (the same-lane warning band at 3.5 m starts about 0.23 m closer)

parameters.parameter: H2: synchronised clocks (one-way travel-time ranging; CSAC or OCXO disciplined to GNSS PPS before the dive)
parameters.source: (a) SA.45s CSAC datasheet: 1 PPS discipline to within 1 ns and 1.0E-12, retrace +-5e-10, aging below 9e-10 per month; (b) field demonstrations of synchronous-clock OWTT: Rypkema 2022 with a CSAC, Eustice 2011 and Webster 2012 with a low-power TCXO (R3 H2, Q1)
parameters.derivation: see sound_speed_err and clock_offset_m below
parameters.validity: Never power-cycled during the dive; sender PPS-to-emission jitter well below 30 us

parameters.parameter: H3: calibrated 3-D inverted-USBL receiving array on every drone
parameters.source: R3 H3: feasible as research hardware on small AUVs (Rypkema 2022 five-hydrophone pyramid, Jakuba 2021 four-element 38 mm array, Raspi2USBL six elements), not a COTS feature
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Must be 3-D and calibrated: published planar arrays are worst for neighbours near the horizontal plane. Feasibility evidence is class (b); the CLEAN and LOW magnitudes at 2-20 m between moving BlueROV2-class vehicles are not demonstrated in the field

parameters.parameter: sigma_range_m (detection jitter, white, per reception)
parameters.source: (a) SeaTrac range resolution +-0.1 m (two-way, depends on the velocity of sound provided), MicronNav 200 +-0.2 m; (b) WHOI Micro-Modem OWTT TOA 125 us = 18.75 cm, ranges set at 18.75 cm std; ahoi two-way static: 50 % of values within 6 cm of the median; Rypkema 2022 one-way static: 68 % of range errors below 0.7 m (about 30 and 57 m, 7-11 kHz) (R3 P1)
parameters.derivation: one detection with timing jitter sigma_t gives c sigma_t one-way but c sigma_t / sqrt(2) for a round trip, so a two-way +-0.1 m is about +-0.14 m one-way; matched-filter resolution c / (2B): 0.375 m (B = 2 kHz), 0.15 m (5 kHz), 0.094 m (8 kHz)
parameters.validity: CLEAN and LOW assume a wideband (5-8 kHz or more), well-calibrated detector at 2-20 m; MEDIUM sits at the datasheet end and no level reaches the published one-way field figure (open issue O-11). The jitter must also contain the sender trigger jitter, which a two-way figure never shows

parameters.parameter: sound_speed_err (relative std of c_assumed; one range scale factor per run)
parameters.source: (from physics, R3 P2) OWTT range = c_assumed x travel time, so the relative range error equals the relative error of c_assumed; Mackenzie partial derivatives dc/dT = 4.08 / 3.60 / 3.16 / 2.75 m/s per deg C at 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 deg C, dc/dS 1.14-1.29 m/s per psu; refraction is negligible at 2-50 m in one layer
parameters.derivation: 0.3 % = 4.5 m/s, about 1.4 deg C at 15 deg C or 3.8 psu; 1 % = 15 m/s, about 4.7 deg C or 12.5 psu
parameters.validity: Valid only if c_assumed is computed onboard from temperature, depth and a known salinity. CONTRADICTED (R3 P2) for an uncompensated 1500 m/s: field sound speeds of 1426-1481 m/s would be off by 1.3 % to 5.2 %. Code action: H2 in the acoustic_channel.py docstring now states the onboard estimate
parameters.code_action: changed: the onboard sound-speed estimate is an explicit assumption (docstring H2)

parameters.parameter: clock_offset_m (std of a drone clock offset expressed as a range; constant per run)
parameters.source: (a) SA.45s CSAC; (b) Rypkema 2022: CSACs drift less than 100 us per 24 h in holdover; Jakuba 2021: CSAC about 1 ppb against about 20 ppb for a TCXO; Eustice 2011: TCXO 20 ns/s typical, below 300 us per 24 h on the bench, below 4 us in a 1.5 h dive (R3 P3)
parameters.derivation: a constant fractional frequency offset y gives a range error c y t; per ppb over 1 h: 5.4 mm (c = 1500 m/s). Table in ACOUSTIC_CHANNEL_MODEL.md section 4
parameters.validity: CLEAN bounds a CSAC over 1 h; LOW and MEDIUM correspond to an OCXO or a measured TCXO over 1 h, or to uncalibrated constant hardware delays. A TCXO at 20 ns/s reaches 0.11 m per drone (0.22 m between two drones) after 1 h, i.e. the 0.21 m envelope bound. For longer missions model offset0 + drift t

parameters.parameter: sigma_az_deg and sigma_el_deg (direction of arrival, white, receiver body frame)
parameters.source: (a) SeaTrac X150 angular resolution typ. 2 % of range (about +-1 deg), MicronNav 200 1 deg RMS (limited by the heading sensor), older MicronNav +-3 deg, Micro-Ranger 2 array below 3.5 % of slant range; (b) one-way inverted USBL: Rypkema 2022 68 % of azimuth errors below 7.0 deg (static, about 30 and 57 m), Rypkema 2019 -0.11 +- 3.16 deg, Jakuba 2021 better than +-5 deg at low tilt (R3 P4)
parameters.derivation: none (values copied)
parameters.validity: CLEAN and LOW match two-way micro-USBL datasheets that include a heading sensor; MEDIUM is below every published one-way field value. The dominant error of field systems, the array bias, is now a separate term (doa_bias_deg); the remaining gap is open issue O-11

parameters.parameter: doa_bias_deg (array calibration residual: smooth, direction-dependent, fixed per receiver)
parameters.source: phenomenon supported (b): Jakuba 2021 find the arrival-angle error dominated by bias; Rypkema 2022 angle bias depends on azimuth and frequency, largest ahead and astern; R3 P4 recommended a per-run direction-dependent bias of a few degrees. The amplitudes are stress values
parameters.derivation: per axis b(az) = A (sin(az + p1) + sin(2 az + p2)) / 2 with phases p uniform per receiver and axis, so abs(b) <= A. For MEDIUM (A = 3.0 deg, white 2.5 deg) the 68 % quantile of the azimuth error is at most 4.2 deg (normal CDF, computed here), below the 7.0 deg of the static river test
parameters.validity: New since R3 (before the final campaign); only makes the channel harsher. Onboard counterpart: AcousticConfig.doa_bias_deg

parameters.parameter: dropout and dropout_far (per-reception loss at short range and at max_range_m)
parameters.source: (b) ahoi marina test: 97.1 % received at 12 m (91.5-99.5 % at the three good positions at 12, 46 and 99 m), 57.5 % at 24 m, 8.0 % at 152 m; moving uAUV request reception 79-94 %, 70-80 % near a pillar; static two-way ranging 1.8 % lost (R3 P5)
parameters.derivation: p = dropout + (dropout_far - dropout) min(1, d / 50 m); at 2-20 m: 0.023-0.052 (CLEAN), 0.087-0.148 (LOW), 0.212-0.320 (MEDIUM)
parameters.validity: Magnitudes lie inside the measured envelope of a low-cost modem in a harbour at 10-100 m. The model draws independent losses with a linear range ramp, whereas measured loss is position-dependent, not monotonic in range and correlated in time; ahoi figures are 292-476 ms packets, not short identity pings

parameters.parameter: Burst outages (MEDIUM): outage_every_s and outage_len_s
parameters.source: phenomenon supported qualitatively (R3 P6): an acoustic payload can mask or falsely trigger an LBL response (Olson); bursty channel behaviour (ahoi); machinery noise (Li 2025) and impulsive noise (Chitre 2008). No source quantifies outage rates or durations for 20-30 kHz pings near thrusters
parameters.derivation: first start uniform in [4, 40] s, then exponential gaps (mean 40 s) + 4 s: about 9 % of the time
parameters.validity: A sweep over outage length (1-10 s) would show the sensitivity

parameters.parameter: nlos_rx (blocked direct path: probability that a reflected arrival is detected)
parameters.source: no source gives this conditional probability; Olson's over 25 % is an unconditional outlier fraction of one long-range LBL example (R3 P7)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: reflect_extra_m (extra path of a reflected arrival; also the excess of a clear-path multipath episode)
parameters.source: (from geometry, R3 P7b) single surface or bottom bounce between two drones at the same distance h from the boundary, separation d: extra path = sqrt(d^2 + 4 h^2) - d
parameters.validity: Valid for operation 1-3 m from a reflecting boundary and separations of at least 3 m; deeper operation or shorter separations give up to 7-8 m

parameters.parameter: reflect_dir_deg (direction error of a reflected arrival)
parameters.unit: deg (elevation std; azimuth std 0.2 x 25 = 5 deg)
parameters.source: R3 P7c: geometry gives elevation-dominated, signed errors of 5-70 deg for a surface or bottom bounce (a vertical wall errs in azimuth); the magnitude is a stress value
parameters.derivation: arrival elevation = atan(2 h / d): 34 / 22 / 11 / 6 deg at d = 3 / 5 / 10 / 20 m for h = 1 m
parameters.validity: Changed since R3: R3 read N(0, 25 deg) on both axes; the code now draws 5 deg in azimuth and 25 deg in elevation (boundary bounces err mainly in elevation)

parameters.parameter: shadow_loss (direct path shadowed by a hull or a gate bar: ping lost)
parameters.source: Fresnel premise DERIVED (below), loss in dB not calibrated by any source (R3 P8). ahoi mobile data show about 18 dB of receive-gain headroom at 50 m, so a few dB of diffraction loss would rarely cause a loss at 2-20 m: 0.3-0.7 is likely pessimistic
parameters.derivation: first Fresnel radius at mid-path r1 = 0.5 sqrt(lambda d), 20-30 kHz at 1500 m/s: 0.19-0.24 m at 3 m, 0.35-0.43 m at 10 m (the earlier 0.3-0.5 m overstated 3 m)
parameters.validity: The BlueROV2 box (0.458 x 0.576 x 0.254 m) is comparable to r1 at 3-5 m and smaller beyond: partial obstruction, so diffraction filling the shadow is plausible. An air-filled electronics tube reflects strongly, so the shadow need not be weak (physical reasoning only)
parameters.code_action: changed: Fresnel numbers corrected in the docstring

parameters.parameter: shadow_extra_m and shadow_dir_deg (diffracted arrival)
parameters.source: (from geometry, R3 P8b) extra path of the diffracted arrival around an edge offset a at mid-path: 2 (sqrt(d^2 / 4 + a^2) - d / 2)
parameters.derivation: 0.10 m at d = 1 m and 0.035 m at d = 3 m for a = 0.23 m, so 0.10 m is conservative for d of 1 m or more. shadow_dir_deg is a STRESS ASSUMPTION (R3 P8c)
parameters.validity: Covered onboard by RANGE_SLACK_M = 0.15 m

parameters.parameter: latency_s (processing delay after the arrival)
parameters.source: (a) Water Linked M64 about 500 ms typical latency (a communication modem, includes packet duration); (b) Huang 2026: acoustic positioning delays of several hundred ms to a few s (citing others), measured piUSBL system delay about 8 ms; Rypkema 2022: one particle-filter iteration about 500 ms on a Raspberry Pi 3 (R3 P9)
parameters.derivation: physical lower bound: detection cannot end before the whole coded ping (20-40 ms) has arrived; no SeaTrac, MicronNav, Micro-Ranger 2 or UGPS latency figure was found
parameters.validity: Inside the 8 ms - 0.5 s bracket; the onboard staleness bound latency_max_s = 0.40 s is consistent

parameters.parameter: los_outlier, CLEAN level: a clear direct path gives no range outlier
parameters.source: R3 P7: field reports of multipath false maxima and of line-of-sight and boundary-path cancellation without any blocking object contradict the premise (Webster 2012: ranges often not Gaussian, false ranges from multipath; Olson 2006: multipath errors can affect several successive measurements; Rypkema 2022: false maxima in an unobstructed river; Renner 2020: probable cancellation at 24 m with a clear path)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Code action: LOW and MEDIUM now model multipath episodes (next row); CLEAN keeps 0 as the idealised baseline level, by definition
parameters.code_action: changed: episodes added at LOW and MEDIUM; CLEAN idealised

parameters.parameter: los_outlier (LOW, MEDIUM) and los_outlier_pings: clear-path multipath episodes
parameters.source: phenomenon supported (b) by the field reports listed in the previous row; no source gives the probability of an episode or its length (channel docstring: stress values)
parameters.derivation: with probability los_outlier per reception an episode starts on the link and lasts los_outlier_pings receptions on average; the time of arrival is that of a boundary bounce, longer by a fixed excess drawn once per episode from reflect_extra_m, while the array still resolves the direct path: slowly varying ranges that mimic valid data (Olson)
parameters.validity: Added after R3, before the final campaign; only makes the channel harsher. Onboard counterpart: AcousticConfig.los_excess_max_m

parameters.parameter: TDMA slot length and collision handling (guard_s removed)
parameters.source: (from design and geometry, R3 P10 and P11) collision freedom of the TDMA schedule: the slot exceeds the worst propagation spread at 50 m (33 ms) plus a 20-40 ms ping. TDMA requires good time synchronisation (Chitre 2008); collisions grow with the number of transmitters (Binder 2016)
parameters.derivation: slot = period_ticks // n ticks at 30 Hz, giving 500 / 333 / 233 / 200 / 167 ms for n = 2..6. R3: guard_s (10 ms) was defined but never read and is shorter than any real ping
parameters.validity: Code action: the unused guard_s field was removed from AcousticChannel. The applied rule (beacon.py): pings whose engine results can share one receiver buffer (2-tick window, 67 ms) are all lost; it never triggers with slots of 167 ms or more. Identities are static codes: receivers are assumed able to separate distinct pinger codes

parameters.parameter: period_s (ping period)
parameters.source: (b) Rypkema 2022: one-way beacon at 1 Hz triggered by the GPS PPS; Jakuba 2021: sweeps at 4 Hz; products 2-4 Hz (UGPS G2), up to 3 Hz (Micro-Ranger 2) (R3 P11)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Webster 2012 notes modem-packet ranges are not typically made every second: a statement about data packets, not identity pings

parameters.parameter: max_range_m (engine range limit)
parameters.source: (a) all verified products exceed it: SeaTrac 1 km, MicronNav 200 500 m horizontal, Micro-Ranger 2 below 995 m, M64 200 m; ahoi reliable at 150 m (R3 P12)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Conservative. The scenarios use 2-20 m; the 50 m point only anchors the dropout ramp

parameters.parameter: sound_speed (propagation constant for the delivery delay)
parameters.source: (from nominal value, R3 P13) Li 2025 give about 1500 m/s; opened sources span 1426-1540 m/s
parameters.derivation: delay = distance / sound_speed
parameters.validity: Harmless as a propagation constant: a 5 % error shifts delivery by less than 2 ms over 50 m. It is not the onboard c_assumed (see sound_speed_err)

parameters.parameter: check_visible and BLACKOUT level
parameters.source: simulator settings. CheckVisible is a single engine ray that any hull or prop blocks; the channel model turns hull and bar blockage into shadowing (H4). BLACKOUT tests the fall-back to B0
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: Validation sweep and stress levels of the acoustic channel
parameters.value: beacon period 8 s; latency 0.35, 0.45, 0.5, 1, 2 s; jitter 1 s; random loss 0.7, 0.9; bursts 30 s and 60 s every 90 s; asymmetric loss 0.9; blackout (`scripts/run_sensor_robustness_campaign.py` protocols B2_SW-*)
parameters.source: one factor at a time, chosen to cross the onboard acceptance limits; not a model of a product. Latency above latency_max_s = 0.4 s makes every packet stale: 0.5, 1 and 2 s accepted 0 % (claims lost, sonar-only gate), 0.35 s accepted 67.4 % (32.0 % stale: latency plus propagation beyond 0.4 s) and 0.45 s 0 % (100 % stale), against 97.4 % for B2_MEDIUM (final validation, `--phase validation`, gate_single, 2 runs each; the review runs gave 63.6 % and 0 %)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: the freshness limits were not raised to admit the late packets

parameters.parameter: k_sigma
parameters.source: (from the Gaussian) P(abs(z) > 3) = 0.27 % per axis, 0.81 % for at least one of three independent axes (R3 P14)
parameters.derivation: the envelope uses the MEDIUM sigmas, so CLEAN and LOW receptions lie well inside
parameters.validity: Heavy tails are documented (Webster Fig. 14, Olson 2006, Rypkema 2022), so the real exceedance is higher; the residual risk is measured (calibration/analyze_b2_channel.py), not claimed

parameters.parameter: sigma_range_m, sigma_az_deg, sigma_el_deg (declared white sigmas)
parameters.source: (from the MEDIUM channel) equal to the MEDIUM white sigmas
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: Declared before any B2 result; the perception never knows the channel level of a run

parameters.parameter: sound_speed_err (declared scale error)
parameters.source: (from the MEDIUM channel) 3 x 1 %
parameters.derivation: range half-width term 0.03 r
parameters.validity: Violated by an uncompensated 1500 m/s (marina 3.6 % and 5.2 %); requires the onboard c estimate of H2

parameters.parameter: clock_offset_m (declared bias between two clocks)
parameters.source: (from the MEDIUM channel) 3 x sqrt(2) x 0.05 m = 0.212 m: the offset difference of two drones
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: A TCXO at 20 ns/s typical spec reaches it in 1 h (R3 P3)

parameters.parameter: doa_bias_deg (declared array calibration bias)
parameters.source: (from the MEDIUM channel) amplitude of the MEDIUM array bias
parameters.derivation: azimuth and elevation half-widths each include it
parameters.validity: Added after R3, before the final campaign

parameters.parameter: los_excess_max_m (one-sided range extension for clear-path multipath)
parameters.source: (from the channel) upper bound of reflect_extra_m; the measured range can be this much too long, so the error region reaches this much nearer
parameters.derivation: acoustic.region_samples: range samples from max(r - br - 3.0, 0) to r + br
parameters.validity: Added after R3. Consequence (formal B2-M4g): regions this large leave no acoustic exit evidence in the validated gate geometry; the sonar latch applies there

parameters.parameter: heading_err_deg
parameters.source: code comment: own compass bias plus noise (MEDIUM bias 2.0 deg); no external source
parameters.derivation: 2.0 deg MEDIUM bias + 1.0 deg allowance for noise
parameters.validity: Open issue O-8 (derived here from R1 6.2 and nav.py): the allowance is below one std of the MEDIUM per-sample heading noise (57.3 x 0.02 = 1.15 deg); at k_sigma = 3 the bound would be 2.0 + 3 x 1.15 = 5.4 deg

parameters.parameter: tilt_err_deg
parameters.source: code comment: own unestimated roll and pitch of a BlueROV2 holding depth; no external source (the fix rotation uses the heading only)
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: v_bound (speed bound of a neighbour used by the kinematic gate)
parameters.source: (from Envelope and GateRule) max(v_escape, v_max_nominal, v_pass) + w_drift_max = 0.55 + 0.15
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: Error-box half-widths of a fix at range r (summary of the fields above)
parameters.source: (from AcousticConfig) range 3 x 0.15 + 0.03 r + 0.21; azimuth 3 x 2.5 + 3.0 + 3.0; elevation 3 x 2.5 + 3.0 + 3.0
parameters.derivation: sampled 7 x 7 x 7 with a slack of half the diagonal of a grid cell
parameters.validity: Formal B2-A1: 4000 random measurements at 0.5-30 m, worst -0.017 m (must be 0 or below)

parameters.parameter: latency_max_s (a delivery later than this after its arrival is not used)
parameters.source: R3 P9: consistent with the published 8 ms - 0.5 s bracket and with the MEDIUM channel latency 0.25 s
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: none stated

parameters.parameter: nav_err_gate_m (own position error in the gate frame)
parameters.source: code comment: bounded by the map aiding; R1 section 8 finds it equal to a 28.6 m approach at a 2 deg bias (27.5 m with a 1 % DVL scale factor), while MEDIUM runs reported in R1 reach 0.7-1.1 m
parameters.derivation: D sin b = 1.0 m for D = 28.6 m at b = 2 deg
parameters.validity: Open issue O-6. R1: cap the approach distance used in the gate argument or raise it to about 1.2 m if the DVL scale factor is added

parameters.parameter: track_gate_m and RANGE_SLACK_M (kinematic-gate slacks)
parameters.source: code comments: RANGE_SLACK_M covers the diffracted excess of a shadowed path (shadow_extra_m = 0.10 m) and quantisation
parameters.derivation: RANGE_SLACK_M >= shadow_extra_m
parameters.validity: The gate budgets the white part of the errors only (biases are common to two fixes and cancel)

parameters.parameter: exit_confirm (consecutive accepted fixes for an acoustic exit)
parameters.source: (from simulation) calibration/analyze_b2_channel.py, 20 000 trials per level: wrong 'outside the CR' decisions with exit_confirm = 2: 9 / 58 / 129 in about 65 000 receptions (CLEAN / LOW / MEDIUM); with 3: 0 / 3 / 3; wrong 'beyond the exit face': 0 in about 200 000
parameters.derivation: a wrong decision needs consecutive accepted reflections
parameters.validity: Open issue O-12: measured before the envelope was widened (doa_bias_deg, los_excess_max_m) and not re-run for this document (channel_risk.json is dated 2026-10-29 02:00, the code 22:46)

parameters.parameter: tie_window_s, fresh_s, depth_tol_m, REINIT_S, _KEEP_S
parameters.source: design constants; fresh_s is described as one lost ping plus the latency (period 1.0 s + 1.0 s + MEDIUM latency 0.25 s = 2.25 s, computed here, against 2.5 s in the code); depth_tol_m: a fix this far outside the operating depth band is a reflection
parameters.derivation: none
parameters.validity: The depth check uses Envelope.z_min and z_max

parameters.parameter: status_fresh_s (age beyond which a report of not engaged no longer excludes a drone)
parameters.value: 2.5 s cap (`config.py AcousticConfig.status_fresh_s`); per plan min(2.5, t_min - latency_max_s): 2.5 s for every gate plan since the queue lines moved back (bounds (c), (d) of GateRule.queue_s; st_gate_pair had 1.946 s with the v11 line at -4.18 m)
parameters.source: (from the gate geometry) t_min = (cr_s_min - queue_s - R_OUT - queue_tol - nav_err_m) / v_bound, the smallest time from the queue point to the CR entry plane at the speed bound
parameters.derivation: the cutoff keeps a report fresh only while the sender cannot have reached the CR since it was sent
parameters.validity: a claim is never dropped by age; distinct from the 32 s S2h horizon

parameters.parameter: t_silent_gate_s (gate silence: rule D, a drone not heard this long may be dead for the gate decisions)
parameters.source: rule D: a drone not heard for t_silent_gate_s by a receiver that hears another drone is dead for the gate decisions (its claim included) only if last known outside the exclusion zone of the gate (holo_fleet/scope.py); otherwise it holds the gate for ever. The comment that introduced the value argued that a live drone cannot stay unheard this long on a queue link (a channel-model estimate P(silence >= 70 s) < 1e-3 per mission in an archived design note) while a dead drone has risen above the gate by then; that estimate is not recomputed here
parameters.doi_or_url: holo_fleet/perception/acoustic_gate.py; holo_fleet/scope.py; formal/check_status.py; formal/check_fleet.py; holo_fleet/referee/robustness_metrics.py; archive v13-final-v11-2026-11-18 (final validation, seeds 8000-8001), run_metrics.json -> premise_v
parameters.derivation: T_DEAD = ceil(70 / 5) = 14 steps > T_VAC = 9 (vacancy before death) and > T_RISE = 10 steps (the hull has left the queue corridor) in formal/check_fleet.py; 70 > FAIR + status_fresh_s = 37.5 s, so under the fairness premise no live drone is held dead (premise V follows); 70 > t_occ_max + t_clear = 26 s. With 1 Hz pings a 70 s silence needs about 70 consecutive lost receptions; the MEDIUM model draws losses independently per reception (bursts of 4 s), so the risk lies in correlated losses, which that model does not represent: under MEDIUM_HT P(outage >= 70 s) = (6 / 70)^1.2 = 0.052 per outage, and the sweep bursts of 60 s stay below 70 s
parameters.validity: Premise V (no live drone declared dead) holds in all 34 runs of the final validation (premise_v.live_declared_dead = 0); longest live-sender silence there 32.2 s (38 s margin). A live drone silent for 70 s outside the zone violates premise V and can release its claim, so P2 depends on premise V; inside the zone silence never releases a claim (safe stop, S4 / S12 of formal/check_status.py). Simulator channel only; no field evidence

evidence.simulator_calibration: final validation: premise_v.live_declared_dead = 0 in 34 / 34 runs; longest live-sender silence 32.2 s; the archived channel-model estimate (< 1e-3 per mission) is not recomputed
evidence.mathematical_derivation: T_DEAD 14 > T_RISE 10 and > T_VAC 9 steps; 70 > 37.5 s (fairness bound) and > 26 s (t_occ_max + t_clear); MEDIUM_HT tail (6 / 70)^1.2 = 0.052
evidence.engineering_design_choice: 70 s: well above the longest live silence and the 60 s sweep bursts, below the time after which a fleet stuck behind a dead claim would be unacceptable
evidence.operating_assumption: premise V: the channel never silences a live drone for 70 s at a receiver that hears another drone (correlated outages of this length are excluded)
